title: Applied ML Modeling — Reproducible Classification Evidence
problem: Build a leakage-safe, reproducible supervised-learning workflow with a trivial baseline, training-only cross-validation, held-out evaluation, serialized model artifact, reloadable inference, and clean-environment CI evidence.
constraints: Benchmark dataset is used only to witness modeling mechanics; no clinical utility claim is made.
Test data cannot fit preprocessing or model parameters.
Model quality must be measured against a trivial baseline.
Production ML deployment is not claimed.
demonstrated_capability: scikit-learn Pipeline construction with StandardScaler + LogisticRegression
5-fold stratified cross-validation on training data only
held-out accuracy, F1, and ROC AUC evaluation
GitHub Actions clean-environment model training and acceptance tests

external_witness.claim: applied-ml-modeling workflow run 1 passed training, automated modeling-boundary tests, metric inspection, and artifact upload

limits: No production model serving or MLOps deployment witness.
Benchmark performance is not a clinical-use claim.
